messages.content: Write a polished short scene in modern American English between two adult friends who have known each other for many years. Let a shared memory emerge naturally through something happening in the present. Do not stop the scene to explain their entire history. Reveal the familiarity through specific details and their reactions.

“Don't touch that.”

Alex froze with her hand over the thermostat.

Jordan looked across the room. “You always turn it down too far.”

“It is hot.”

“It is not.”

“You said that last winter.”

“And I was right.”

“You made me wear two sweaters.”

“One sweater.”

“Two.”

Jordan smiled. “The green one didn't count.”

Alex stared at her. “You remember the green sweater?”

“I remember you complaining about it for three months.”

“You bought it.”

“Exactly.”

Alex lowered her hand from the thermostat. “I hated that sweater.”

“You still wore it.”

“Because you kept bringing it over.”

Jordan shrugged. “You needed it.”

There was a brief pause.

Alex looked at her. “You still do that.”

“Do what?”

“Decide what I need before I do.”

Jordan smiled. “Someone has to.”

Alex shook her head, but she was smiling too.
